dict.string: Health Export reads your step count, heart rate, active energy, sleep analysis, and workouts from Apple Health so you can preview those samples and export a copy as CSV or JSON. The files stay on this iPhone until you choose to save or share them. The app does not upload your health data.
Health Export does not write, update, or delete any information in Apple Health. This description is required by HealthKit when initializing the HealthKit store, even though this app is read-only.
